# The Analysis of Mind

*[Russell](../philosophers/russell.md) · 1921*

The book in which Russell adopts [neutral monism](../glossary/neutral-monism.md): the stuff of the world is neither mental nor material, and what we call a mind is only a grouping of events following psychological laws. The substantial self is abandoned for a series bound together by [mnemic causation](../glossary/mnemic-causation.md).
